scenario_description:
Objective: Reach the Cambridge City Hall Annex hearing room for the morning civic-access roundtable with tactile transit-equity map packets.
Emerging Need: The building-entry attempt begins with fare travel and a valid lobby badge scan, then stops when the elevator reader changes to staff override and stairs are the only public route offered.
Decision Context: The workable recovery depends on combining the stalled lobby status and badge details with stored Annex escort instructions rather than the public outage notice alone.
Consequence: If escort coordination is not attempted during the hearing-floor security window, the same entry attempt cannot get her into the room for check-in.

parameter.title: Cambridge Civic Access Roundtable
parameter.description: Visitor check-in opens at 08:40. Bring tactile transit-equity map packets for the mobility access discussion.
parameter.location: Cambridge City Hall Annex, Hearing Room 204

parameter.subject: Visitor badge for today's Civic Access Roundtable
parameter.body: Your visitor badge CCA-2198 is active today from 08:40 to 09:05 at the Cambridge City Hall Annex main lobby readers for the Civic Access Roundtable in Hearing Room 204.

parameter.description: Red Line fare toward Cambridge City Hall Annex roundtable

parameter.content: I’m through the Annex lobby scanner with badge CCA-2198, but the elevator panel switched to “staff override only” after accepting the QR. The stair marshal is sending people upstairs by stairs, so I’m stuck in the lobby with the tactile map packet.

parameter.subject: Annex visitor elevator reader outage this morning
parameter.body: The Cambridge City Hall Annex main visitor elevator readers are offline until approximately 09:30. Lobby security cannot add new unlisted visitor escorts after 08:55 because the hearing-floor security sweep is already underway.
